description: Capture a screenshot of a website

captureBeyondViewport.description: Allow the capture to include content beyond the configured viewport

disableAnimations.description: Freeze CSS/JS animations and transitions before capturing

fallbackToFullPage.description: If selector is not found, fall back to a full-page capture instead of failing

highlightLinks.description: Draw borders around links (useful for AI vision)

inline.description: Return image data inline instead of a CDN URL

pageHeight.description: Height of page for partial screenshot

removeBackground.description: Remove page background for a transparent PNG (PNG only)

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to capture, instead of the full viewport/page

theme.description: Color scheme to render before capturing

name: screenshot
